Falcon-7B-base has been sampled with CFG (\gamma > 1) on the prompt 'The dragon flew over Paris, France', and no negative prompt, measuring the differences log probabilities across the entire vocabulary at each generation step.

The results show that CFG encourages token related to 'dragon' and 'Paris' and discourages other topics and regions, by noting more tokens related to the former in the top5 at each time step, and more tokens related to the latter in the bottom5 at each time step. As shown in Table 3.
